description: Hands the project's committed record to the session as it opens: the decisions in force and the adopted patterns, by name. Before a file is written, hands over the rules of the record addressed at that path — and where a rule of that record asks for it, pauses the write until a person decides, citing the rule. Every one of those is recorded as a fact of the chain. Each can be switched off with `mnema switch`, which records that it was.
